info.description: Enterprise-grade E2E Postman Suite for the IT External Ticketing Service Domain (BIAN-aligned, ADR-001/005/013/019/030/031/032/033). Registers a Jira and a ServiceNow connection that NAME the environment variables holding their credentials (the answers say whether each is set and never carry a secret), retrieves, lists, updates (the maps are replaced), checks (the credentials variable is deliberately not set, so the provider is never called), disables and enables, and reads the audit ledger in order. A disabled connection links nothing. A second folder covers linking at the edges (an item that does not exist, a connection that does not exist, bad payloads), a third proves the service is staff only (a REQUESTER gets 403 ERR-ETK-00403), and a fourth the negative guarantees: validation, the address policy (plain http, cloud-metadata and private addresses, credentials in the URL are refused), secret names that are not variable names, duplicate names (409), tenant isolation, the webhook refusing a missing or wrong token (401) and an unknown connection (404), and the absence of DELETE, with RFC 7807 error_code assertions. The two-way sync with a real provider double is proved by the platform smoke (external-ticketing-smoke). It files everything under its own generated tenant id (etkOrganisationId), so it needs no organisationId from the Party Reference Data Directory.
info.name: IT External Ticketing Service - Connector Suite
